goal: Authenticated regular users and administrators can use a prototype-aligned, responsive shared shell with accessible drawer behavior, working preferences, localized search feedback, and unchanged permission boundaries.
non_goals: Do not implement a command palette or global search backend.
Do not move locale selection into the topbar.
Do not change routes, backend authorization, APIs, persistence, or administrator capabilities.
Do not restyle route-family content or add dependencies.
Do not copy prototype fixtures or JavaScript into production.
expected_evidence: Focused component tests covering shell dimensions, drawer interactions, permissions, theme toggle, locale copy, locale discovery filtering, and unavailable search feedback.
Full frontend Vitest, targeted Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript, Vite build, and git diff output.
Desktop and 390px browser evidence in dark Simplified Chinese plus representative light or English coverage.
Task report with A2 and A3 coverage.
Independent spec and quality review artifacts.
unsafe_assumptions: Prototype administrator fixtures do not replace production permission checks.
A prototype command palette does not authorize simulated production success without a real contract.
Resolved theme and stored auto preference are distinct existing behaviors.
Visual hiding alone does not prove accessible drawer behavior.
Filesystem entries under src/assets/locales may include AppleDouble metadata that is not a valid locale.
stop_condition: Stop before editing outside the ten allowed files, changing backend/router authorization, or inventing a search/data contract.
